title: Tell Them I Love (Some) Randomness
coreMove: Invite variation only where losses are clipped and learning or upside can compound.
sourcePressure: This chapter argues for selective randomness where downside is limited and upside remains open.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Confusing bounded randomness with liking chaos everywhere.

sourceAnchors.name: bounded randomness
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter loves only some randomness, specifically where downside is limited and upside stays open
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Randomness earns a place only when it cannot bankrupt the room.

sourceAnchors.name: selective exposure
sourceAnchors.detail: the sorting rule that separates useful variation from destructive noise
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The right exposure is a small door for loss and a wide door for discovery.
